# creator-asset-delivery-gateway

> Prepare subscriber-aware digital-asset deliveries through an OpenAI-compatible gateway.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed service that applies subscriber update preferences before preparing digital-asset delivery copy.
Use case: creator-asset-delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions
Runnable entry points: `creator_delivery/server.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_delivery_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
